public_rationale: OpenAI reports o1 superiority in 54 of 57 MMLU subcategories, implying non-winning cases in the remainder. limitations: The supported comparison is principally against GPT-4o, not specifically the original GPT-4.
The result applies to the contemporaneous models and evaluations.
The evidence does not establish statistical significance for each individual non-winning category.
